body:
this is the showgirl era the way it sits on longlivets.com right now — feathers, burnt-orange glitz, and a little "current era" tag, because it's the chapter we're all still standing in. 🧡

the life of a showgirl arrived last october to the biggest opening any album has ever posted: 4.002 million units moved in seven days, the largest single week the charts have measured since they started counting this way back in 1991 — past a record that had held for a decade. built, unusually for now, on people actually buying the thing: vinyl, cds, the lot.

on the site we've laid the whole chapter on a timeline — the announcement, the portraits, a song-by-song guide to the record, each milestone with a citation attached instead of a rumor. the kind of page you can just scroll and lose an afternoon in.

step into the current era: longlivets.com/?era=tloas&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=era-tloas-showgirl-records

(pictured: the showgirl era, as it lives on longlivets.com)
why: Why this: paired Instagram sibling of the TLOAS '12' era-deep-cut (same campaign era-deep-cut:tloas-showgirl-chart-records), satisfying the unconditional X+IG pairing rule. Different facet + >20% divergence: the X leg is the Hot 100 twelve-for-twelve sweep; this IG leads on the biggest-album-debut-ever record and the era-page artifact, mentioning the sweep not at all. Fact sourced exactly to supabase/seed/content/the-life-of-a-showgirl.mjs (line ~938-945): 4.002 million equivalent units in week one (charts dated 2025-10-18), the largest single week for any album by equivalent units AND pure sales since Luminate's modern methodology began in 1991, past Adele's decade-old 25; ~3.48M of it pure sales incl. 1.334M vinyl. Media: /social/library/era-tloas-screen.png (mediaKind site-screen, 1080x1350 = aspect 0.800, in-range; NOT a generic /eras/ tile so it clears the era-art gate; fresh — not among the last 10 posted IG media and not shared with any queued item). No cleared TLOAS photo exists (photo corpus is only lover/red/fearless/debut, and red+fearless+debut are all inside the last-10 IG repeat window), so the era product surface is the correct, publishable, on-brand media here; the grid stays Taylor-forward (3 of the last 5 posted IG were real Taylor photos). Hook: 'the artifact' — opens on what the image is (calendar's 08-30 IG hook). Scheduling: 2026-08-30T23:00Z fills 08-30's open IG slot (the calendar's 08-30 IG was a droppable, un-sourceable reputation photo slot; no cleared reputation photo exists); cap-safe (no other IG scheduled 08-30). Link /?era=tloas (valid era slug). Blocklist discipline: pure chart/business record — no relationship/Kelce, no family, no 'provocative visual' framing (all present in this era's Vault entry, all deliberately excluded). Voice: lowercase-heavy fan voice; no surname overuse; no lyrics in body (the lyric visible in the screenshot is the product's own, not the caption's); no AI-tell phrases. NOTE for Tree: this uses the TLOAS era product screen inside the Blank Spaces window as a sourceable substitute for the un-sourceable 08-30 reputation slot — flag if it collides with any planned September TLOAS beat.
